name: salonpro
description: SalonPro - Complete Hair Salon / Barbershop Website + CRM + Admin + Staff Panel + Customer Portal (MERN)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
